column1: GRADE-ROLL PROFILES BY TRAINER TYPE. Final per-city % is EMERGENT: base profile mask x city progress ramp x G4-strip. Not a fixed per-city table.

column6: Mid - G3 core, G2/G4 spread, no G1
Strong - G2 core, some G3, NO G1/G4
Top - G2 core, G1 appears, no G4

column2: weight 0 = forbidden / 1 = some (x1) / 2 = favored (x2.5 via FACTOR)
Start from the city's base grade weights (the wild/prof/event gradeWeights for that row).
applyStoryProgressToGradeWeights ramps weights upward with badges (k = 0.20 early / 0.30 mid / 0.40 late, plus an extra post-Gym-6 ramp). Higher city = stronger skew toward G1/G2.
Multiply by the trainer-type profile mask above (FACTOR [none=0, some=1, favored=2.5]).
storyStripGrade4IfPartyMature zeroes G4 once the player's party has >=2 mons (so late enemies stop fielding fodder).
Signature grade ceiling: non-exempt trainers (leaders, elite trainers, gym trainers) cap sig grade to the row's available grades
As trainer quality rises (Basic -> Gym Trainer/Elite -> Leader/Rival -> E4/Champion) the profile shifts the whole distribution toward stronger grades
column3: both the floor AND ceiling of grade rolls rise with the city so the enemy keeps pace with the player's evolving team.
